fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the box image on dlp games' product page https://www.dlp-games.de/en/spiele/reef-gardens. The publisher product title and release year correspond to this rule edition; reduced to 227 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went diving at a coral reef begins; otherwise choose someone at random.
clarifications: Beginning with that player, turns proceed clockwise. The same opening instruction covers the standard game and Atolls variant.
internalEvidence: Downloaded the English booklet linked from the publisher's Reef Gardens page and rendered page 3. The Game Play paragraph gives both the coral-reef criterion and random fallback, plus clockwise turns. Page 1 credits dlp games ©2025. uncertainty: The booklet does not specify what qualifies as diving or how to resolve a shared most-recent dive.
